messages:
Clem: hey folks — hitting a few blockers on first-day setup, can anyone help? Okta is stuck on a 'verifying device' loop so I can't finish SSO, Google Drive shows I don't have access to team folders, 1Password invite says 'seat pending', and `ssh git@github.com` gives Permission denied (publickey). MacBook Air M2, macOS 13.5.

Jamie (People Ops): welcome Clem!! tagging infra and IT. can you confirm the email you used for 1Password and Google? also did you enroll Okta Verify or try passkey? :wave:

Clem: email is clem@redwood.com. I tried Okta Verify push and it never completes — just a spinner that says "verifying device". I did not set up a passkey. 1Password invite went to that address and shows "seat pending" in the invite email.

IT Support Bot: 1Password invitation resent to clem@redwood.com — check spam. If it still says seat pending after acceptance, reply here and I'll escalate.

Nish: hi Clem — quick checks: 1) Do you see the Okta device enrollment prompt in your browser or in the Okta Verify app? 2) For the SSH issue, please paste the output of `ssh -v git@github.com` (redact any long hex lines). Also confirm you have an SSH key at `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`.

Clem: paste: "debug1: Offering public key: /Users/clem/.ssh/id_ed25519 ED25519" then "Permission denied (publickey)." I do have a `id_ed25519` and a `id_rsa` in ~/.ssh.

Maya: for Google Drive access we rely on group provisioning from Google Workspace. Jamie, did the provisioning job include Clem in the 'Eng' OU? Clem, can you try visiting drive.google.com and search for the folder name — sometimes inherited perms take a minute after group sync.

Kelly (Manager): pinging IT via DM too — if we can get drive + repo access today that would be great.

Nish: Permission denied means GitHub doesn't have your public key. Steps: 1) If you don't mind, generate a new key with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "clem@redwood.com"` then `pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` and paste it into your GitHub profile -> SSH and GPG keys. 2) If you already added it, ensure your local ssh agent is loaded: `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" && ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`.

Clem: ran the commands and added the pub key in GitHub web UI. `ssh -T git@github.com` now responds with "Hi clem! You've successfully authenticated" — nice.

IT Support Bot: Okta: we cleared a stale device enrollment record for clem@redwood.com and forced a fresh enrollment. Try logging in again and accept the push in Okta Verify. If you prefer passkeys, go to Okta > Settings > Security and follow the passkey setup.

Clem: okay I retried in a private window and the Okta Verify push finally completed. I see the Google Drive team folders now. 1Password still says seat pending after accepting the invite — the invite link redirected and said account created but UI shows pending seat.

IT Support Bot: Thanks — created internal ticket IT-7421 to finish seat provisioning. In the meantime, if you need access to secrets, we can create a temporary shared folder and add you.

Jamie (People Ops): great progress. Clem — let us know if you need temporary creds, otherwise IT will update here when the 1Password seat is active. Also welcome to the Eng channel, will post intro thread shortly. :tada:

Nish: one more note for future: if device trust dialogs get stuck, clear Okta cookies for the domain and retry in a private window. Also macOS team uses the keychain integration, so `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain` is handy.

IT Support Bot: Update: 1Password seat for clem@redwood.com activated (IT-7421 resolved). Please sign out/in of 1Password desktop app or accept the new invite.

Clem: confirmed — I can see the org vaults and the 1Password desktop autostarted. everything working now, thanks all for the quick help! :party-parrot:

Kelly (Manager): awesome — welcome aboard Clem! I'll loop you into the onboarding doc and assign first-week tasks.

Maya: welcome — see you in the eng-standup tomorrow.

Jamie (People Ops): closing the loop here — if anything else pops up, ping #new-hires or DM me.
